commands.name: m98_planned_larger_batch_repeat

decision_rule: Use the larger-batch repeat to decide whether M96's remaining lateral negative seed was sample-limited or objective-limited.
failure_criteria: same M96 objective settings are not preserved
larger-batch repeats still show negative after-lift on any future-envelope target
result is used for PPO before repeated-seed objective evidence is stable
hypothesis: M96 equal per-target contrast may pass the strict objective gate with more rollout samples and lower held-out variance.
success_criteria: same M96 objective settings are used
larger batches provide more held-out samples than M96
braking yaw and lateral after-lift are all positive across repeated seeds
decision states whether PPO continuation is still blocked
